notes: Real, citable reference datasets used to convert live clean-energy output into environmental-impact estimates. Values are documented and swappable per region. Loaded at runtime by SustainabilityDatasets.cs; the C# fallbacks mirror these numbers.

gridEmissionFactor.source: CEA CO2 Baseline Database for the Indian Power Sector, Version 21.0
gridEmissionFactor.sourceDetail: Weighted-average grid emission factor, FY2023-24 (0.727). FY2024-25 provisional: 0.710. Published by the Central Electricity Authority, Government of India.

lifecycleCarbonIntensity_gCO2e_per_kWh.source: IPCC AR5 WG3 Annex III, Table A.III.2 (Schlomer et al., 2014) - lifecycle emission medians
lifecycleCarbonIntensity_gCO2e_per_kWh.sourceDetail: Median lifecycle gCO2eq/kWh: wind onshore 11, utility solar PV 48, coal (PC) 820, gas (CCGT) 490. Battery storage ~25 is an added-overhead estimate for round-trip-stored renewables.

householdConsumption.source: India household electricity-consumption survey (urban average ~1,937 kWh/household/yr; rural ~1,486)
householdConsumption.sourceDetail: Swap annual_kWh per region to localise the 'homes powered' estimate (e.g. US EIA average household ~10,500 kWh/yr).

treeSequestration.source: US EPA Greenhouse Gas Equivalencies Calculator / urban forestry
treeSequestration.sourceDetail: A mature urban tree sequesters ~21.8 kg CO2 per year (=> ~45.9 trees per tonne of CO2 per year).
